newsitem.title: USA: Delta revenue gains outpaced costs in Q2.
newsitem.headline: Delta revenue gains outpaced costs in Q2.

text.p: Delta Air Lines Inc said its revenues per seat mile rose 2.3 percent in the just-concluded second quarter, compared with a one percent increase in costs.
Delta said operating revenues per available seat mile rose to $0.0935, while costs on the same basis edged to $0.0869, up from $0.0861 a year ago.
The company cited a 25 percent increase in fuel prices for the higher costs and said without it, fiscal second quarter operating costs per available seat mile declined 2.5 percent year-over-year.
